nodes.description: Address of the underlying want token (StrategyBaseline.want); used for balances, approvals and transfers.
Governance address initialised to msg.sender in the constructor and mutable through SetGovernance; guards admin setters.
Controller contract address; the only authorised caller for withdraw/withdrawAll and the source of vault mappings.
Intermediate received token (Curve LP token) address configured by SetRecv.
Vault address for the want token, resolved from Controller.vaults(want).
Vault address for the recv token, resolved from Controller.vaults(recv).
Constant Curve REN pool address 0x93054188d876f558f4a66B2EF1d97d16eDf0895B.
int128 index of the want coin inside the Curve REN pool.
Constructor setting governance = msg.sender, controller and want.
Governance-guarded setter writing the governance state variable.
Governance-guarded setter writing the controller state variable.
Internal setter that assigns recv and derives frecv/fwant from Controller.vaults with zero-address requires.
Deposits want through the DepositToken hook then approves and deposits recv into Vault(frecv).
Controller-only rescue withdrawing a non-want/recv/frecv asset back to the controller.
Controller-only partial withdrawal converting frecv -> recv -> want using priceE18 and GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant.
Controller-only full withdrawal unwinding frecv and recv into want.
View computing total strategy value in want terms from frecv, recv and want balances.
Virtual hook implemented by the concrete strategy to convert want into recv.
Virtual hook implemented by the concrete strategy to convert recv back into want.
Virtual price hook returning the recv-in-want price scaled to 1e18.
Constructor deriving want from ICurveFiREN(curve).coins(_index), storing index and calling SetRecv.
Approves want to Curve and calls add_liquidity with a 2-element vector.
Removes liquidity from Curve then swaps all non-want coins back through exchange.
Returns Curve get_virtual_price() divided by 1e10.
Caller; trusted as governance at construction and checked against governance/controller afterwards.
External calls into Vault(frecv): deposit, withdraw and priceE18.
Outbound ERC20 safeTransfer of want/asset to controller or fwant vault.
External calls into the Curve pool: add_liquidity, remove_liquidity, exchange and get_virtual_price.
Constructor parameter for the want token address.
Constructor/setter parameter for the controller address.
SetGovernance parameter for the new governance address.
SetRecv parameter for the intermediate received token address.
Asset argument of withdraw(IERC20) to be drained and sent to the controller.
Amount of want requested in withdraw(uint256).
Amount argument passed to DepositToken/WithdrawToken hooks.
Curve pool coin index supplied to the CurveREN constructor.
Local _want = IERC20(want).balanceOf(address(this)) inside deposit/withdraw.
Local _recv = IERC20(recv).balanceOf(address(this)).
Required recv amount computed as _aw.sub(_w).mul(1e18).div(price).
Local frecv balance valued with Vault(frecv).priceE18() in balanceOf.
Returned balance of the rescued asset in withdraw(IERC20).
uint256[2] memory vector used for Curve add_liquidity.
Balance of a non-want Curve coin that is swapped back via exchange.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted caller msg.sender as governance.
SetGovernance requires msg.sender == governance before changing governance.
SetController requires msg.sender == governance before changing controller.
withdraw(IERC20) requires msg.sender == controller.
withdraw(uint256) requires msg.sender == controller.
withdrawAll requires msg.sender == controller.
Constructor parameter _want is written into the want state variable.
Constructor parameter _controller is written into controller.
Constructor initialises want.
Constructor initialises governance from msg.sender.
Constructor initialises controller.
SetGovernance writes parameter _governance into governance.
SetGovernance reads governance for the authorisation check.
SetController reads governance for the authorisation check.
SetController overwrites the controller state variable.
Parameter _controller is written into controller.
SetRecv consumes parameter _recv.
SetRecv assigns recv = _recv.
SetRecv calls Controller(controller).vaults(...).
SetRecv passes want as the key of Controller.vaults.
recv is validated against address(0) after being stored.
fwant is derived from Controller(controller).vaults(want).
frecv is derived from Controller(controller).vaults(recv).
recv is the lookup key that produces frecv.
deposit reads the want balance of the strategy.
deposit reads the recv balance before vault deposit.
deposit approves recv and calls Vault(frecv).deposit.
Local _want balance drives the DepositToken call.
Local _recv balance guards the vault deposit.
deposit dispatches to the DepositToken hook when want balance is positive.
deposit performs an external Vault(frecv).deposit call that transfers control.
withdraw(IERC20) consumes parameter _asset.
Balance of _asset is captured in the returned variable.
withdraw(IERC20) requires want != address(_asset).
withdraw(IERC20) requires recv != address(_asset).
withdraw(IERC20) requires frecv != address(_asset).
withdraw(IERC20) safeTransfers the whole asset balance to the controller.
withdraw(uint256) consumes parameter _aw.
withdraw(uint256) reads and finally transfers the want balance.
withdraw(uint256) reads and withdraws the recv balance.
withdraw(uint256) reads frecv balance and priceE18.
Remaining want is safeTransferred to the fwant vault.
_ar = _aw.sub(_w).mul(1e18).div(GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant()) is unchecked-style arithmetic composition.
withdraw(uint256) calls the WithdrawToken hook.
withdraw(uint256) calls Vault(frecv).withdraw before finishing its own transfers.
withdraw(uint256) safeTransfers want to fwant after external calls.
withdrawAll reads the frecv balance.
withdrawAll reads the recv balance.
withdrawAll reads the want balance and transfers it out.
withdrawAll sends the entire want balance to the fwant vault.
withdrawAll performs a full external Vault(frecv).withdraw.
withdrawAll calls the WithdrawToken hook.
withdrawAll safeTransfers the resulting balance to fwant.
balanceOf reads the frecv balance.
balanceOf reads the recv balance.
balanceOf reads the want balance.
Local frecv balance is priced with Vault(frecv).priceE18().
balanceOf calls Vault(frecv).priceE18() as an external view.
balanceOf calls the GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant hook.
CurveREN constructor consumes parameter _index.
Constructor assigns index = _index.
DepositToken uses index to select the vector slot for add_liquidity.
WithdrawToken skips the index coin when swapping.
CurveREN constructor calls SetRecv(0x49849C...3675).
CurveREN constructor chains into StrategyBaseline's constructor.
Parameter _amount flows into the virtual DepositToken hook.
Parameter _amount flows into the virtual WithdrawToken hook.
DepositToken approves and adds _amount of want as liquidity.
WithdrawToken approves and removes _amount of recv liquidity.
Curve pool constant is the approval spender and add_liquidity target.
Curve pool constant is used for remove_liquidity and exchange.
Curve pool constant is queried for get_virtual_price.
want is approved to the Curve pool in DepositToken.
recv (LP token) is approved to the Curve pool in WithdrawToken.
Local vector vec carries the deposit amount for add_liquidity.
Local _bal of each non-want coin is exchanged into want.
index is compared with the loop counter to skip the want coin.
Virtual DepositToken hook is overridden by the CurveREN implementation.
Virtual WithdrawToken hook is overridden by the CurveREN implementation.
Virtual GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant is overridden by the CurveREN implementation.
DepositToken calls ICurveFiREN(curve).add_liquidity, an untrusted external contract.
WithdrawToken calls remove_liquidity and exchange on Curve while holding balances.
GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant reads Curve get_virtual_price.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _want is only used to initialise the want state variable and the parent constructor.
Parameter _controller flows directly into the controller state variable set by the constructor and SetController.
Parameter _governance is written by the access-controlled SetGovernance function.
Parameter _recv is consumed by SetRecv to assign recv and derive frecv.
Parameter _asset is only meaningful inside the controller-only withdraw(IERC20) emergency function.
Parameter _aw is the requested amount processed by withdraw(uint256) arithmetic and transfers.
Parameter _amount is forwarded to the concrete DepositToken/WithdrawToken hooks implemented by the CurveREN strategy.
Parameter _index is stored by the CurveREN constructor and drives pool coin selection.
Local _want balance exists solely to decide whether deposit calls DepositToken.
Local _recv balance exists solely to decide whether deposit calls Vault(frecv).deposit.
Local _ar is the arithmetic result used by withdraw(uint256) to pull from the vaults.
Local frecv valuation is computed inside balanceOf using Vault(frecv).priceE18().
Local balance is the return value of the controller-only withdraw(IERC20) transfer.
Local vec array is only used as the add_liquidity argument in DepositToken.
Local _bal is only used to exchange stray Curve coins back into want inside WithdrawToken.
